lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草都不响一声。
lines.en: Where I pass, not a blade of grass rustles.

lines.zh: 七格外我就淡了，你看不见。
lines.en: Beyond seven blocks I fade; you cannot see me.

lines.zh: 幽匿感测器听不见我的脚步。
lines.en: The sculk sensor cannot hear my footsteps.

lines.zh: 我的轮廓到得比脚步声早。
lines.en: My outline arrives well before any footstep does.

lines.zh: 商队的路我走过千遍，只是不响。
lines.en: I walked the caravan road a thousand times, silently.

lines.zh: 一步落下，风把它接走了。
lines.en: I set a foot down and the wind carries it off.

lines.zh: 我飘着走，脚底离地半寸。
lines.en: I drift along with my soles half an inch off ground.

lines.zh: 经过你背后，你只会觉得凉。
lines.en: Passing behind you, I only leave a chill.

lines.zh: 我绕过营火，火苗不歪。
lines.en: I circle the campfire and its flames stay straight.

lines.zh: 七格是界线，跨过去我才显形。
lines.en: Seven blocks is the line; cross it and I show.

lines.zh: 铃铛不响，因为我按住了它。
lines.en: The bell stays silent because I hold it still.

lines.zh: 我的脚印太浅，沙子自己填了。
lines.en: My prints are so shallow the sand fills them.

lines.zh: 我数着商队留下的车辙。
lines.en: I count the wagon ruts the caravan left behind.

lines.zh: 安静的时候，我几乎不存在。
lines.en: In the quiet, I almost stop existing.

lines.zh: 八层甲贴在身上，像层雾。
lines.en: Eight layers of armor sit on me like mist.

lines.zh: 我记得驮过的货，很沉。
lines.en: I remember the goods I carried; they were heavy.

lines.zh: 现在没有羊驼，也没有铃。
lines.en: Now there are no llamas, and no bells.

lines.zh: 我站着，让菌丝慢慢缠手腕。
lines.en: I stand still and let mycelium wind around my wrists.

lines.zh: 七十点生命，藏在很轻的身子里。
lines.en: Seventy health hides inside this weightless body.

lines.zh: 风从我袖口穿过，带走一点菌。
lines.en: Wind slips through my cuffs and carries off some spores.

lines.zh: 我不喘气，所以藏得住。
lines.en: I do not breathe, and that is why I hide.

lines.zh: 这里太吵，我躲进影子待着。
lines.en: This place is too loud; I wait inside a shadow.

lines.zh: 我把货单在心里念了一遍。
lines.en: I recite the cargo list once inside my head.

lines.zh: 菌丝从领口爬出来，又缩回去。
lines.en: Mycelium crawls from my collar, then withdraws.

lines.zh: 等天黑，七格就变成十四格。
lines.en: When night falls, seven blocks become fourteen.

lines.zh: 我连自己的呼吸都听不见。
lines.en: I cannot even hear my own breathing.

lines.zh: 我把商队的地图折好，塞回怀里。
lines.en: I fold the caravan map and tuck it away.

lines.zh: 菌丝在甲片下面轻轻动。
lines.en: Mycelium stirs gently beneath the plates.

lines.zh: 我学过的招呼话，现在没什么用。
lines.en: The greetings I learned are of little use now.

lines.zh: 这身甲不是我挑的，是长出来的。
lines.en: I did not choose this armor; it grew on me.

lines.zh: 你回头了，可我已经不在那。
lines.en: You turned around, but I am no longer there.

lines.zh: 你盯着我，我就慢慢淡下去。
lines.en: Stare at me and I slowly thin into nothing.

lines.zh: 我在看你腰间的钱袋。
lines.en: I am looking at the coin purse at your belt.

lines.zh: 商人的眼睛，先看货再看人。
lines.en: A trader's eyes check the goods before the person.

lines.zh: 你的瞳孔在找我的轮廓。
lines.en: Your pupils are searching for my outline.

lines.zh: 别眨眼，眨眼我就换位置。
lines.en: Do not blink; blink and I switch places.

lines.zh: 我看你，跟看一件货差不多。
lines.en: I look at you much like I look at cargo.

lines.zh: 你听见的是风，不是我的衣角。
lines.en: What you hear is wind, not my sleeve.

lines.zh: 你身上有铃铛，我听得见。
lines.en: You carry a bell; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 我离你七格，正好在界线外。
lines.en: I stand seven blocks off, just past the line.

lines.zh: 你的脸绷得很紧，别怕。
lines.en: Your face is drawn tight; do not be afraid.

lines.zh: 我眨不了眼，这双早就干了。
lines.en: I cannot blink; these eyes dried out long ago.

lines.zh: 七十点生命，藏得很深。
lines.en: Seventy health, hidden very deep inside.

lines.zh: 你的刀划过，像划开一层雾。
lines.en: Your blade passes through like cutting fog.

lines.zh: 疼是真的，形是假的。
lines.en: The pain is real; the shape is not.

lines.zh: 我被劈开，过一会儿又合上。
lines.en: I am split apart, then knit back together shortly.

lines.zh: 八层甲挡不住的，我就躲。
lines.en: What eight plates cannot stop, I simply avoid.

lines.zh: 你打中我，手会先凉。
lines.en: Strike me and your hand goes cold first.

lines.zh: 这点伤，风一吹就淡了。
lines.en: This wound fades as soon as the wind blows.

lines.zh: 别追，我退到七格外就行。
lines.en: Do not chase; I only need to reach seven blocks.

lines.zh: 你的声音我记得，你的刀不记得。
lines.en: I remember your voice, not your blade.

lines.zh: 我缩进影子，你砍的是地。
lines.en: I shrink into shadow; you strike the ground.

lines.zh: 绿宝石我收过很多，现在不数了。
lines.en: I have taken many emeralds; I no longer count them.

lines.zh: 你把货物摆出来，我会想起摊位。
lines.en: Lay out your wares and I remember my stall.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只收走。
lines.en: I do not eat; I only take things away.

lines.zh: 那块面包，我留着当货样。
lines.en: I will keep that bread as a sample of goods.

lines.zh: 你出的价太低，我早不做买卖了。
lines.en: Your price is too low; I quit trading long ago.

lines.zh: 引诱一个看不见的东西，很难。
lines.en: Tempting something you cannot see is difficult.

lines.zh: 你手里的东西越亮，我越靠近。
lines.en: The brighter the thing in your hand, the closer I drift.

lines.zh: 交易要两个人，我只剩一个半。
lines.en: A trade needs two; I am only one and a half.

lines.zh: 你放下货物，我就当你答应了。
lines.en: Set the goods down and I take it as agreement.

lines.zh: 别拿食物，拿点值钱的。
lines.en: Skip the food; bring me something of value.

lines.zh: 你撞到的是一阵凉气。
lines.en: What you bumped into was a patch of cold air.

lines.zh: 我就在这，只是你摸不准。
lines.en: I am right here; you just cannot place me.

lines.zh: 别伸手，你的手会穿过去。
lines.en: Do not reach out; your hand will pass through.

lines.zh: 撞上我的时候，我还没显形。
lines.en: When you hit me, I had not yet shown myself.

lines.zh: 你退开半步，我就退回七格。
lines.en: You step half back, and I retreat seven blocks.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙走，墙比人暖。
lines.en: I walk against the wall; the wall is warmer.

lines.zh: 你挤过来，衣角扫到了菌丝。
lines.en: You push in and your sleeve brushes my mycelium.

lines.zh: 我没什么重量，撞不出声。
lines.en: I have almost no weight; collisions make no sound.

lines.zh: 贴到我身上，你就摸到凉风。
lines.en: Press against me and your hand finds cold wind.

lines.zh: 你撞开的是空气，我只挪了半寸。
lines.en: You shoved air; I moved only half an inch.

lines.zh: 我的商队只剩我一个，早散了。
lines.en: My caravan is only me now; it scattered long ago.

lines.zh: 那种事，我飘得太久，忘了。
lines.en: That sort of thing: I drifted too long and forgot.

lines.zh: 你靠近时，我下意识躲开。
lines.en: When you come close, I flinch away by habit.

lines.zh: 同类相遇，会互相看不见。
lines.en: When my kind meet, we simply fail to see each other.

lines.zh: 我把货单叠好，放进怀里。
lines.en: I fold the cargo list and tuck it in my coat.

lines.zh: 陪伴这个词，我念不全。
lines.en: The word companionship, I cannot say it whole.

lines.zh: 被子早就烂了，只剩布条。
lines.en: The blanket rotted long ago; only strips remain.

lines.zh: 我不会留下脚印，也不会留下人。
lines.en: I leave no footprints, and I leave no one behind.

lines.zh: 你要找伴，去找会喘气的。
lines.en: If you want company, find someone who breathes.

lines.zh: 我把手缩进袖子，免得吓着你。
lines.en: I pull my hands into my sleeves so they do not startle you.

lines.zh: 地上的绿宝石，我顺手收了。
lines.en: That emerald on the ground, I pocket it in passing.

lines.zh: 我捡东西不留痕迹，也无声。
lines.en: I pick things up without sound or trace.

lines.zh: 这根缰绳，原来系着羊驼。
lines.en: This lead once held a llama.

lines.zh: 掉下来的货，我替你数着。
lines.en: The goods that dropped, I am counting them for you.

lines.zh: 我弯腰的动作很轻，像没弯。
lines.en: I bend so lightly it looks like I did not.

lines.zh: 那枚铜钱，我留着压货单。
lines.en: I keep this copper coin to weigh down my list.

lines.zh: 我只挑能换钱的，剩下不动。
lines.en: I pick only what trades well and leave the rest.

lines.zh: 别看我手里，看你的口袋。
lines.en: Do not watch my hands; watch your pockets.

lines.zh: 捡到布，我会摸摸料子。
lines.en: When I find cloth, I feel the weave first.

lines.zh: 我收得很快，你回头就没了。
lines.en: I take it quickly; look back and it is gone.

lines.zh: 你走出七格，我就开始跟。
lines.en: Once you pass seven blocks, I start following.

lines.zh: 铃铛响了，那就是你。
lines.en: A bell rings, and that means it is you.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊了就不算偷袭。
lines.en: I do not call out; a call would spoil the ambush.

lines.zh: 你选了这条夜路，我选了等你。
lines.en: You chose this night road; I chose to wait.

lines.zh: 目标确认，我把自己收进风里。
lines.en: Target confirmed; I fold myself into the wind.

lines.zh: 你背后的凉意，不是天气。
lines.en: The chill behind you is not the weather.

lines.zh: 商队的老规矩，先看有没有护卫。
lines.en: Old caravan rule: check for guards before anything.

lines.zh: 你跟谁来的？我数数人头。
lines.en: Who came with you? Let me count heads.

lines.zh: 别回头，回头我就不在。
lines.en: Do not look back; if you do, I am gone.

lines.zh: 你已经在我七格里了。
lines.en: You are already inside my seven blocks.

lines.zh: 我贴着你的影子走，一步不差。
lines.en: I walk in your shadow, step for step.

lines.zh: 你听不见我，但你能感觉到。
lines.en: You cannot hear me, but you can feel me.

lines.zh: 我把呼吸的位置让给了风。
lines.en: I gave my breathing's place over to the wind.

lines.zh: 再走十格，你就到没人的地方了。
lines.en: Ten blocks more and you reach an empty place.

lines.zh: 我在等你停下，好省点力气。
lines.en: I wait for you to stop and save my strength.

lines.zh: 你的脚步声替我打了节拍。
lines.en: Your footsteps keep time for me.

lines.zh: 别走快，我跟得很轻松。
lines.en: Do not hurry; following you is easy.

lines.zh: 我从下风处来，味道先到不了。
lines.en: I come from downwind; my scent arrives late.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，照不出我。
lines.en: That torch in your hand cannot light me up.

lines.zh: 前面是死路，我早看过了。
lines.en: The road ahead is a dead end; I checked.

lines.zh: 我的手从背后搭上你的肩。
lines.en: My hand settles on your shoulder from behind.

lines.zh: 十点伤害，轻得像被风推。
lines.en: Ten points of damage, light as a shove of wind.

lines.zh: 你倒下时，才看清我的轮廓。
lines.en: Only as you fall do you see my outline.

lines.zh: 这一下不响，所以你来不及。
lines.en: This blow makes no sound, so you are too late.

lines.zh: 我抓的是你的领口，不是脖子。
lines.en: I grab your collar, not your throat.

lines.zh: 别转身，转身会更冷。
lines.en: Do not turn; turning will only feel colder.

lines.zh: 八层甲压下来，像一件湿袍。
lines.en: Eight layers of armor press down like a wet robe.

lines.zh: 你在原地转圈，我就在圆心。
lines.en: You spin in place, and I stand at the center.

lines.zh: 这一掌带走了你的体温。
lines.en: This palm strike takes your body heat with it.

lines.zh: 我出手时，你才听见衣角。
lines.en: Only when I strike do you hear my sleeve.

lines.zh: 那头流浪商人的羊驼，没跟来。
lines.en: The wandering trader's llamas did not follow me.

lines.zh: 我在链接断掉的那晚变了。
lines.en: I changed the night the link snapped.

lines.zh: 铃铛还在，声音没了。
lines.en: The bell is still here; its sound is gone.

lines.zh: 我从七格外的雾里显出来。
lines.en: I surface from the mist seven blocks away.

lines.zh: 这片林子太静，适合我。
lines.en: This forest is quiet enough for me.

lines.zh: 我带来的第一件事，是安静。
lines.en: The first thing I bring is silence.

lines.zh: 谁把货单落在路上了？
lines.en: Who left this cargo list on the road?

lines.zh: 我闻到了菌，闻到了家。
lines.en: I smell fungus, and I smell home.

lines.zh: 我站在这里，你大概看不见。
lines.en: I stand right here; you probably cannot see me.

lines.zh: 天黑了，我的界线变宽了。
lines.en: Night has come, and my boundary has widened.

lines.zh: 我数了数周围，没有幽匿。
lines.en: I counted the surroundings; there is no sculk.

lines.zh: 别点灯，灯照不到我，只照到你。
lines.en: Skip the lamp; it lights you, not me.

lines.zh: 火把我照出来了，这下难躲。
lines.en: Fire lights me up; now hiding is harder.

lines.zh: 我从半空落下去，落地无声。
lines.en: I drop from midair and land without a sound.

lines.zh: 水比空气重，我浮不起来。
lines.en: Water is heavier than air; I cannot rise.

lines.zh: 爆炸撕开了我，形状一时没拼好。
lines.en: The blast tears me open; my shape does not knit right away.

lines.zh: 箭从我胸口穿出，扎进泥里。
lines.en: The arrow leaves my chest and buries itself in mud.

lines.zh: 那道咒把我定在原地片刻。
lines.en: That spell holds me in place for a moment.

lines.zh: 我早就不用吃东西了，可还是虚。
lines.en: I stopped needing food long ago, yet I weaken.

lines.zh: 雷光把我照得清清楚楚。
lines.en: The lightning flash shows me completely.

lines.zh: 我往下坠，连风都不跟。
lines.en: I fall, and even the wind does not follow.
